description: Ministry of Power and Energy - The Regulations of Energy Performance Standards of Appliances (Refrigerators) No. 01 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Power and Energy under the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority Act, establishing energy performance standards for refrigerators. It creates new regulatory requirements for manufacturers, importers, and sellers, including mandatory compliance with specific standards, labeling requirements, and certification processes. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the creation of new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
